newsitem.title: UK: Allied up on switch from Grand Met.
newsitem.headline: Allied up on switch from Grand Met.

text.p: Shares in British drinks maker Allied Domecq pushed higher on Tuesday as investors acted on a Kleinwort Benson recommendation to take profits in Grand Met and funnelled the funds into Allied, market sources said.

Market sources said Kleinwort Benson, which has Allied on its buy list, advised taking profits in Grand Met on valuation grounds, noting that the company was at a four percent premium to the market for 1997 and Allied was at a 10 percent discount.
Allied shares were up 6-1/2p or 1.4 percent at 480p in an otherwise weak market while Grand Met was unchanged at 475-1/2p.
